message.content:
Opioids are **not all derived from the same source**: some are **natural** compounds from the **opium poppy plant**, while others are **semi-synthetic** drugs made by chemically modifying those natural compounds, and others are **synthetic** drugs made entirely in laboratories.[1][2]

- **Natural opioids (opiates)** come from the **seed pods of the opium poppy** and include **morphine, codeine, opium, and thebaine**.[1][3]
- **Semi-synthetic opioids** are made in a lab from natural opiates; examples include **heroin, oxycodone, hydrocodone, and oxymorphone**.[1][4]
- **Synthetic opioids** are **manufactured entirely in labs** and do not come directly from plant material; **fentanyl** is one example.[1][4]

If you want, I can also explain the difference between **opioids** and **opiates** in one sentence.
